title: TenderNet: data and code for Dispersed awards, persistent ties: evidence from Türkiye's public IT procurement (unreleased revision)
description:
Unreleased revision of archived TenderNet v1.0.1. No new archival deposition is asserted. Code, derived data and sources support Dispersed awards, persistent ties: evidence from Türkiye's public IT procurement (F. Aksoy, A. Şimşek).

The keyword-defined main sample contains 9,991 awards. Observed repeat purchasing exceeds specified permutation benchmarks under alternative category and history definitions. Concentration depends on weighting and time period. Conditional award associations and simulations do not identify switching costs or causal mechanisms. Currency conversion, provenance, classification uncertainty and human-validation requirements are documented.

Code: MIT; derived data: CC BY 4.0. Natural-person winners are pseudonymized. Underlying public records originate from KİK/EKAP.
notes: Derived data in data/ are licensed CC-BY-4.0 (see data/LICENSE); code is MIT. Underlying records: Kamu İhale Kurumu (KİK), EKAP, https://ekapv2.kik.gov.tr.
